en.headline: Hang Seng adds 188 points at the Tuesday midday close
en.dek: The index finished the morning at 24,228 after touching 24,354, with turnover above HK$54 billion and the tech index up nearly 0.9 percent.
body: Hong Kong stocks extended Monday's gain into Tuesday lunchtime. The Hang Seng Index closed the morning session at 24,228, up 188 points, or about 0.8 percent, after rising more than 310 points to a session high of 24,354, RTHK reported.

Main-board turnover for the half-day was more than HK$54 billion. The Hang Seng Tech Index stood at 4,220, up nearly 0.9 percent. Among the large technology names, Alibaba led with a gain of close to 3 percent, while Meituan was unchanged, RTHK said.

Artificial-intelligence model stocks were firmer, with Zhipu up 8 percent after Amazon Web Services connected the company's model, and MiniMax up nearly 3 percent. Drug and biotech shares also rose, with Wuxi Biologics and Sino Biopharmaceutical each up more than 4 percent. J&T Express was the strongest blue chip, gaining more than 4 percent. Some consumer stocks fell, and heavyweight financials were mixed.
A separate Sing Tao account put the midday reading at the same 24,228, up 188 points or 0.78 percent, and the half-day turnover at HK$54.048 billion, with northbound trading still absent.

zh.headline: 恒指半日升188點 報24228點
zh.dek: 指數曾高見24354點，其後升幅收窄，半日主板成交逾540億元，科指升近0.9%。
body: 港股星期二延續上日升勢。港台報道，恒生指數最多曾升逾310點，高見24354點，中午收市報24228點，升188點，升幅約0.8%。
半日主板成交額逾540億元。科技指數報4220點，升幅近0.9%。ATMXJ之中，美團無起跌，其餘升幅介乎近1%至近3%，阿里巴巴升幅較大。
人工智能大模型股造好，智譜升8%，港台稱亞馬遜雲科技已接入其大模型；MINIMAX升近3%。醫藥及生物科技股上升，藥明生物和中生製藥升逾4%。極兔速遞升逾4%，是升幅最大藍籌股。部分消費股下跌，重磅金融股個別發展。
星島另報中午升188點或0.78%，同報24228點，半日成交540.48億元，並指在缺乏北水下成交仍然偏低。
